title: Predictive Thermostated Dynamics and Subgrid Reservoir Modeling
exact_target: Determine whether thermostat models predict short-time nonequilibrium dynamics and correlations, and how to couple unresolved energy reservoirs.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30001531 (OWR-4415-004). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mathematical Theory and Modelling in Atmosphere-Ocean-Science (2010), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2010/34, pp. 2027--2099; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF pages 20--21, printed pages 2046--2047.

status_qualification: Correct equilibrium averages do not by themselves guarantee correct transient dynamics or correlations. The source asks both dynamical validation and reservoir/vector-field modeling questions; no particular universal thermostat or numerical tolerance is fixed.
